summary: This Form 6-K reports adjourned extraordinary general meeting results for Virax Biolabs Group Limited. Shareholders approved a share consolidation (1-for-10 to 1-for-30 range) and adoption of amended articles. No quorum was present initially; adjourned meeting proceeded with less than one-third of shares represented. No price, premium, advisor, or deal mechanics are involved. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
